evidence_policy.rule: IMPLEMENTED != VERIFIED; VERIFIED requires acceptance criteria evidenced against the exact source SHA and required gates.
evidence_policy.merge_policy: Never auto-merge; preserve required gates and branch protections.

functions.title: Gate discovery and root-cause repair
acceptance_criteria: Failures tied to exact SHA/run/job/step
Fixes preserve all gates

functions.title: Evidence lifecycle and verification
acceptance_criteria: REGISTERED→RUNNING→ANALYZED→VERIFIED lifecycle supported
Failures become FAILED/BLOCKED; verified items may be reopened as RESIDUAL

functions.title: Capability security and process/resource isolation
acceptance_criteria: No ambient authority
Capability checks enforced at kernel boundary
Required isolation tests pass

functions.title: Virtual memory mapping mutation and lifetime
acceptance_criteria: Mutation rollback and bottom-up table cleanup tested
Mapping/object lifetimes prevent stale references

functions.title: TX-V2 deterministic signing and encoding
acceptance_criteria: secp256k1 ECDSA RFC6979/SHA-256, low-S and compressed SEC1 key vectors pass
Legacy domains and Ed25519 transaction signing rejected

functions.title: ATCB validation, execution limits and gas
acceptance_criteria: ATCB magic/version/count parsed deterministically
Program/stack/storage limits and malformed-bytecode rejection tested

functions.title: Aurora intent-policy-capability-approved tool execution
acceptance_criteria: Proposal→Policy→Capability Check→Approval→Tool→Service Boundary→Authoritative Runtime
Aurora is not kernel TCB, consensus or chain authority

functions.title: Cross-repository integration and conformance
acceptance_criteria: Contracts and canonical owners mapped
No duplicate production implementations
